// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(int input) { int value = input; value = value + input; return value; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(int input) { int input = 2; return input; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(int input) { int value=input; { int value=2; int inner=value; inner; } return value; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(bool condition) { if(condition) { int value=1; return value; } else { int value=2; return value; } }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(bool condition) { if(condition) { int value=1; } int value=2; return value; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample() { int value=value; return value; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(int input) { int value=input; { int value=value; value; } return value; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(bool condition) { if(condition) { int inner=1; } return inner; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(int input) { const int value=input; value=2; return value; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
int sample(int input) { int value=input, other=value; return other; }

// λ🧭 binding probe
pub fn sample(input:i32)->i32 { let mut value = input; value = value + input; value }

// λ🧭 binding probe
pub fn sample(input:i32)->i32 { let input = 2; input }

// λ🧭 binding probe
pub fn sample(input:i32)->i32 { let value=input; { let value=2; let inner=value; inner; } value }

// λ🧭 binding probe
pub fn sample(condition:bool)->i32 { if condition { let value=1; value } else { let value=2; value } }

// λ🧭 binding probe
pub fn sample(condition:bool)->i32 { if condition { let value=1; } let value=2; value }

// λ🧭 binding probe
pub fn sample()->i32 { let value=value; value }

// λ🧭 binding probe
pub fn sample(input:i32)->i32 { let value=input; { let value=value; value; } value }

// λ🧭 binding probe

// λ🧭 binding probe
pub fn sample(input:i32)->i32 { let value=input; let other=value; other }

# λ🧭 binding probe
extends RefCounted
func sample(input:int)->int:
	var value:int = input
	value = value + input
	return value

# λ🧭 binding probe
extends RefCounted
func sample(input:int)->int:
	var input:int = 2
	return input

# λ🧭 binding probe
extends RefCounted
func sample(input:int)->int:
	var value:int=input
	if true:
		var value:int=2
		var inner:int=value
	return value

# λ🧭 binding probe
extends RefCounted
func sample(condition:bool)->int:
	if condition:
		var value:int=1
	var value:int=2
	return value

# λ🧭 binding probe
extends RefCounted
func sample()->int:
	var value:int=value
	return value

# λ🧭 binding probe
extends RefCounted
func sample(input:int)->int:
	var value:int=input
	if true:
		var value:int=value
	return value

# λ🧭 binding probe
extends RefCounted
func sample(input:int)->int:
	const value:int=1
	value=2
	return value

# λ🧭 binding probe
extends RefCounted
func sample(input:int)->int:
	var value:int=input
	var other:int=value
	return other
